source_caption:
Tom Cruise has performed many of his own stunts across the entire Mission: Impossible saga—from hanging off a real plane during takeoff to climbing the Burj Khalifa—making the franchise famous for its commitment to practical, high-risk action.

Mission: Impossible (1996–2025), directed by various, starring Tom Cruise, Ving Rhames, Simon Pegg. A long-running action saga that follows Ethan Hunt and his IMF team through increasingly daring missions, blending espionage, teamwork, and some of the most ambitious stunts ever put on screen.

source_details.title: Mission: Impossible
source_details.synopsis: Mission: Impossible is a 1996 American spy thriller film directed by Brian De Palma, and produced by and starring Tom Cruise from a screenplay by David Koepp and Robert Towne and story by Koepp and Steven Zaillian. Based on the 1966 television series of the same name and its 1988 sequel series, it is the first installment in the Mission: Impossible film series. It also stars Jon Voight, Henry Czerny, Emmanuelle Béart, Jean Reno, Ving Rhames, Kristin Scott Thomas and Vanessa Redgrave. In the film, Ethan Hunt (Cruise) seeks to uncover who framed him for the murders of most of his Impossible Missions Force (IMF) team.
